fit_reason: Whole car, a 2003 Mercedes CLK430 convertible, listed by a private owner.
findings: Paint looks dull and flat across the hood, fenders and doors, with little gloss or reflection
Light grime and dust along the lower rocker panels and front bumper
Black fabric soft top looks faded and dusty
Visible wear and soiling on the driver seat bolster and the front of the passenger seat
Driver footwell carpet and mat look dirty
Steering wheel rim and dash surfaces look grimy and worn-looking
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the CLK430 convertible. The silver paint looks a bit dull in the photos, and the light gray seats and carpet are showing some soil and wear. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a machine buff and a full interior clean, which can really help the photos and showings. Would you like a quote?
